threshold_rule: abs(assembly_span_bp - median_original_read_span_bp) > max(2, ceil(0.05 * max(assembly_span_bp, median_original_read_span_bp)))
assembly_span_source: direct flank trim of each edited FASTA; ledger checked afterward
read_span_source: source-guided unique natural flank trim of unchanged original read; confirm boundaries against primary context PAF CIGAR
record_vs_molecule_boundary: SRA record IDs distinct; original PacBio ZMW unavailable, so molecule-qualified and biological accuracy are not evaluated
